column1: # Reviewed alias overrides (changes go through a reviewed pull request).
#   cpe     <name or CPE key>   <canonical CPE product>    a CNA name (in the
#           CPE naming convention, part "a") or an alternate CPE product is
#   vendor  <CNA vendor key>    <CPE vendor>               a CNA vendor name
#           is this CPE vendor (used only where vendor:product is a known
# Keys are lower case, in the CPE naming convention. Learned mappings never
# override an entry here. Seeded from the platform's curated product list.
# The kernel CNA names the product "Linux" by vendor "Linux".
# Upstream enrichment consistently states the 1809 CPE for this product.
